**BETA: for testing. Not offered to people on the stable version.**

New in this beta: **Expand link**. Paste a short link (t.co, bit.ly, ty.gl, vm.tiktok.com…) into the app and tap **Expand**: you see every step the link goes through and the real, cleaned destination. Redirect wrappers (Facebook, Google, Adjust…) are read without a request.

- Contacts the link's own servers to follow it (no cookies, no referrer). Never requests addresses on your own network (localhost, home router…).
- Installs over your current BorraLoco (same signing key). To go back, install the latest stable release.
- Not tried on every phone: tell me what you see.
